Flow.description: This Screen Flow is used by the Investment Performance team to create composite benchmarks. It guides the user step-by-step to select components, assign weights, and generate a new composite benchmark record.

formulas.name: DescriptionFormula
formulas.expression:
IF( AND(NOT( ISBLANK( {!SearchIndexrep2.recordId} )),ISBLANK( {!SearchIndexrep3.recordId})) , ( {!Compo1}&' + '&{!Compo2} ), IF( AND( NOT( ISBLANK( {!SearchIndexrep3.recordId})), ISBLANK( {!SearchIndexrep4.recordId}) ), ( {!Compo1}&' + '&{!Compo2}&" + "&{!Comp3} ) , IF( AND( NOT ( ISBLANK( {!SearchIndexrep4.recordId})), ISBLANK( {!SearchIndexrep5.recordId} ) ), ( {!Compo1}&' + '&{!Compo2}&" + "&{!Comp3}&' + '&{!Comp4} ), IF( AND(NOT (ISBLANK( {!SearchIndexrep5.recordId} )), ISBLANK( {!SearchIndexrep6.recordId} )), ({!Compo1}&' + '&{!Compo2}&" + "&{!Comp3}&' + '&{!Comp4}&' + '&{!Comp5} ), IF( NOT (ISBLANK( {!SearchIndexrep6.recordId} )), ( {!Compo1}&' + '&{!Compo2}&" + "&{!Comp3}&" + "&{!Comp4}&" + "&{!Comp5}&" + "&{!Comp6} ), ({!SearchIndexrep.recordName})
)))))

formulas.name: WeightSum
formulas.expression:
IF( AND(NOT( ISBLANK( {!Weight2} )),ISBLANK( {!Weight3} )) , ( {!Weight1}+{!Weight2} ), IF( AND( NOT( ISBLANK( {!Weight3} )), ISBLANK( {!Weight4} ) ), ( {!Weight1}+{!Weight2}+ {!Weight3} ) , IF( AND( NOT ( ISBLANK({!Weight1}+{!Weight2} )), ISBLANK( {!Weight5}) ), ( {!Weight1}+{!Weight2}+ {!Weight3} +{!Weight4} ), IF( AND(NOT (ISBLANK({!Weight5} )), ISBLANK( {!Weight6} )), ({!Weight1}+{!Weight2}+ {!Weight3} +{!Weight4}+{!Weight5} ), IF( NOT (ISBLANK( {!Weight6})), ( {!Weight1}+{!Weight2}+ {!Weight3} +{!Weight4}+{!Weight5}+{!Weight6} ), ({!Weight1})
)))))
